fusions.name: Bobbin Bounce
fusions.desc: Flicks a weighted bobbin that deals 7 damage to the first enemy it meets, then hops to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles, each hit dealing 60% of the original damage. It holds 4 charges, and a kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Tethered Leap
fusions.desc: Leaps to an enemy up to 6 tiles away and bites for 12 damage, making it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds, and leaving a thread tied to it that slows it by 30% for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Springboard Sheet
fusions.desc: Springs you 3 tiles off a stretched sheet, then raises your movement speed by 30% and your dodge chance by 10% for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Pieced Jumper
fusions.desc: A hopper stitched from scraps fights beside you, striking for 2 damage every 0.5 seconds within 4 tiles.
